rubric.evidence: Re-verified 2026-11-27 against ChromeStatus API 5077742779498496 (stage 460 desktop_first: 151; top-level status still 'Proposed', accurate_as_of 2026-07-13). Both sides of the status divergence are transparently documented alongside Chrome Enterprise Help system requirements and Apple Support macOS compatibility articles.

Correctly filed under v151 with immutable ChromeStatus identity 5077742779498496; clearly states Chrome 150 is the final release for macOS 12 Monterey and Chrome 151+ requires macOS 13 Ventura or later.

Live MDN check on 2026-11-27 confirmed MDN does not publish Chrome desktop OS support deprecation pages (and no web-features entry exists on webstatus.dev). reference-contract.json remains implementation-sufficient with all four anchor selectors (#at-a-glance, #syntax, #examples, #browser-compatibility) preserved.
Clearly explains Apple's macOS 12 EOL rationale, stranded Chrome 150 warning-infobar behavior, unpatched security risk, installer refusal for Chrome 151+, and Mac hardware upgrade boundaries.

Includes a working, semantic <pre tabindex='0'><code> User-Agent Client Hints detection example verified with 0 failures by scripts/doc-tests.mjs; minor deduction because enterprise fleet auditing often uses MDM/osquery rather than browser UA-CH.
Platform support banner and Mac hardware compatibility table clearly cover affected Mac generations, maximum supported macOS versions, and Chrome 150 vs 151+ update eligibility.

Every visible source and citation label links directly to its primary artifact with target='_blank' rel='noopener' (ChromeStatus feature/API/milestone, Chrome Enterprise Help, Apple Support 103260/102861/105113, ChromiumDash, MDN NavigatorUAData); zero legacy-host URLs.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2 outline, role='note' on platform-status banner and End-of-support warning callout, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'> in keyboard-focusable .table-wrap regions, and <pre tabindex='0'> code block.

Upgraded to modern editorial shell (/public/styles.css + /public/favicon.svg) with logical max-inline-size: 100% on .table-wrap, focus-visible ring, and horizontal table scroll verified with zero overflow on desktop (1280x800) and mobile (360x740).
Preserves exact route-bindings.json demo: null (OS platform support removal is not a runnable web-platform demo) without modifying immutable conformance.json.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive tables horizontal scroll keyboard focusable accessible documentation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Place all content within semantic landmarks (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>), maintain sequential heading levels, and provide <caption> and <th scope='col|row'> inside keyboard-focusable scroll regions for wide data tables.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: wrapped both data tables in tabindex='0' role='region' .table-wrap containers with <caption> and explicit <th scope>, added <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, and added role='note' to banners and warnings.

guidanceConsulted.query: semantic html landmarks navigation accessible headings callout banner
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native HTML5 landmarks (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>), <pre tabindex='0'><code> for keyboard-scrollable code blocks, and explicit <tbody> sections in tables.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: added tabindex='0' to the UA-CH <pre><code> block, explicit <tbody> wrappers in both tables, and standard modern editorial landmarks.

guidanceConsulted.query: modern css responsive layout logical properties
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing properties (max-inline-size) and avoid duplicating shared stylesheet rules locally.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: removed legacy inline .doc-table/.warn-block overrides in favor of /public/styles.css plus minimal logical .table-wrap { max-inline-size: 100%; } and :focus-visible styling.
